definitions.explanation: A loss or negative consequence suffered by someone. Often used in legal, business, and formal contexts to describe unfavorable outcomes or treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不利益|ふりえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It will be to the detriment of consumers.

examples.japanese: {不利益|ふりえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{被|こうむ}った→被る：18070_koumuru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}て→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please come forward if you have suffered a disadvantage.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不利益|ふりえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じない→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧よう⟦{配慮|はいりょ}する→配慮する：26831_hairyosuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Care must be taken to ensure this change does not cause disadvantage to employees.

notes:
USAGE:
{不利益|ふりえき} is a formal term used primarily in legal, business, and administrative contexts. It is the antonym of ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧ (benefit, profit).

In labor law, {不利益|ふりえき}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧ (disadvantageous change) and {不利益|ふりえき}⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧ (disadvantageous treatment) are important legal concepts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不利益|ふりえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{被|こうむ}る→被る：18070_koumuru⟧: to suffer a disadvantage
- {不利益|ふりえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧: for a disadvantage to arise
- {不利益|ふりえき}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: disadvantageous change (legal term)
- {不利益|ふりえき}⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧: disadvantageous treatment
